title: vibes hub
tagline: Things I've vibe coded. Click one and poke at it.
_how_it_works: Every public repo of yours with GitHub Pages turned on shows up here automatically. Android apps are listed below under "android" (by repo name); their cards link to the latest release. Use the other settings to hide repos, override titles/descriptions/emoji, feature favorites, or add pages that live somewhere else.

android.title: Media Widgets
android.description: Home-screen widgets for whatever's playing: audiobooks (Libby, Audible), YouTube Music, Pocket Casts, plus a Now Playing grid.

android.title: Now
android.description: One tap to say what you're doing right now. No timers: each tap ends the last thing.

android.title: Repos Widget
android.description: My GitHub repos at a glance: latest CI run and commit, plus update chips for installed apps.
